Docket 1.3.132

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A postcode in the footer is found.* A site with its full address and postcode in the footer of every
  page was told no postcode appeared anywhere, and to put one in the footer. That check read only the
  main content of each page; it now reads the footer too, as Docket's other address checks already did.
- *A map drawn by a site builder is a map.* A contact page whose map is a builder's map widget, holding
  its own coordinates, was told it had no map.
- *A trade's licence counts as proof.* A homepage saying the business is licensed and insured, and
  naming the state board that licenses it, was told no certifications appeared anywhere on it.
- *Fallback fonts are not counted as typefaces.* Some builders give each web font a stand-in, a font the
  computer already has, sized to match until the real font arrives. Those stand-ins were counted as
  extra typefaces the visitor downloads; they are no longer counted.
- *Sites built with Duda and GoDaddy are named correctly.* Duda sites showed no platform at all, and
  sites built with GoDaddy's builder were shown under the name of a GoDaddy subsidiary.

99 checks across 13 areas.
